future_structure.rule: Each department head may receive child Bot workers with narrower owner_scope. Child Bots never inherit parent forensic authority.

management_cycle: Bots persist replies and evidence references
BOT1 reconciles agreement, conflict and minority views
BOT1 converts synthesis into department-level next_actions
Department heads may delegate to child Bots
Child outputs return to parent department
Local forensic gates alone may change gate state
